_note: Voiceover and on-screen steps. 'say' is spoken (written for the voice), 'cap' is the caption shown. shot = screenshot number in shots/, tap = [x,y] in screenshot pixels (1170x1992), focus = point the camera centres on.

intro.say: This is the B S Car Rentals manager. Your whole rental business, right on your phone. Let's go through it, one step at a time.

lines.cap: The dashboard shows your whole day.
lines.say: When you open it, the dashboard shows your whole day.

lines.cap: How many cars are free, and how many are out.
lines.say: You can see how many cars are free, and how many are out with customers.

lines.cap: Money collected this month, and money still due.
lines.say: It also shows the money collected this month, and the money still due.

lines.cap: Anything that needs your attention is listed here.
lines.say: And anything that needs your attention, like a late car, or an expired paper, is listed right here.

lines.cap: All 25 cars in one list. Filter by available or rented.
lines.say: All twenty five cars are in one list. You can filter them by available, rented, or under service.

lines.cap: Tap a car to see its trips, earnings and kilometres.
lines.say: Tap any car to see its trips, the money it has earned, and its kilometres.

lines.cap: Damage not yet repaired is shown in red.
lines.say: Any damage that has not been repaired yet is shown in red.

lines.cap: Each customer has a page with every rental and payment.
lines.say: Each customer has their own page, with every rental and every payment.

lines.cap: See what they have paid, and what they still owe.
lines.say: You can see what they have paid, and what they still owe.

lines.cap: Call or WhatsApp them in one tap.
lines.say: And you can call them, or message them on WhatsApp, with one tap.

scenes.title: Rent out a car in a minute

lines.cap: Choose the customer and the car. No double bookings.
lines.say: To rent out a car, choose the customer and the car. The same car can never be given to two people at once.

lines.cap: The price is worked out for you.
lines.say: The price is worked out for you, from the dates and the daily rate.

lines.cap: Note km and fuel, and tick the condition checklist.
lines.say: Before you hand over the keys, note the kilometres and fuel, and tick the condition checklist.

lines.cap: Every car that is out, and when it is due back.
lines.say: The rentals page shows every car that is out, and when it is due back. Late returns are marked in red.

lines.cap: The advance paid, and the balance left.
lines.say: Open a rental to see the advance paid, and the balance left.

lines.cap: Send a WhatsApp reminder in one tap.
lines.say: You can send the customer a WhatsApp reminder, with one tap.

lines.cap: Enter the kilometres, fuel and condition.
lines.say: When the car comes back, enter the kilometres, the fuel, and the condition.

lines.cap: Extra km, late hours or damage go on the bill.
lines.say: Extra kilometres, late hours, or new damage are added to the bill.

lines.cap: The before and after check is saved.
lines.say: And the before and after check is saved, so there is no confusion later.

lines.cap: Everyone who still owes you money, in one list.
lines.say: The money due page lists everyone who still owes you money.

lines.cap: Late payments are shown in red.
lines.say: Payments that are late are shown in red.

lines.cap: Send a polite WhatsApp reminder from the list.
lines.say: Send a polite WhatsApp reminder, straight from the list.

lines.cap: Reminders before insurance or PUC expires.
lines.say: It keeps track of insurance and P U C dates, and reminds you before they expire.

lines.cap: And when a car is due for service.
lines.say: It also tells you when a car is due for service.

lines.cap: Money collected, rentals and expenses.
lines.say: Reports show the money collected, the number of rentals, and your expenses.

lines.cap: Download to Excel any time.
lines.say: You can download them to Excel, at any time.

lines.cap: Give each staff member their own login.
lines.say: Give each staff member their own login.

lines.cap: You choose what they can see and do.
lines.say: You choose exactly what they can see, and what they can do.

lines.cap: Nothing is ever deleted.
lines.say: And nothing is ever deleted, so you always have a full record.

outro.say: Everything in one place. It works on any phone or computer, with no app to install. Just open B S car rental dot co dot in, slash manage.
